rv.q: Lawrence Boothman stars in a terrifically entertaining Scots version of Dario Fo and Franca Rame’s subversive stories at Glasgow’s Òran Mór
A masterclass in thought-provoking storytelling, Mistero Buffo is a must-see production.
A thoroughly worthwhile revival, it still kicks and thrills in equal measure.
This is an incredible one-man show that will blow your mind.

cn.t: Julian Spooner delivers an extraordinary performance in this timely revival of Dario Fo's satirical masterpiece, full of surprises and inventive storytelling that remains powerfully relevant to today's political landscape.
